method: Read-only Figma Plugin API inventory. Counts include repeated screen states, style specimen frames, and own-visible nodes whose ancestors may be hidden; frequency is not importance. Layout metrics are explicit Auto Layout properties, not inferred CSS. Original files were not edited.
